card.name: Time span words before "to weeks"
card.fires_on: The word "days" in the PML warning phrase "progress over days to weeks". Also "moderate" right before "or severe" in severity ranges.

modes.label: Days before to weeks

card.writes: It promotes range words like "to" and "至" and suppresses "either", so the model expects the second end of a range.
card.plain: It fires on the first end of a range, such as "days" in "days to weeks", where the next words give the other end.
